metadata.title: Urban Hip-Hop Portrait with High-Contrast Duotone Background

retrievalProfile.description: A high-contrast urban portrait featuring a close-up subject in full color against a desaturated, red-tinted architectural background with heavy shadows and distressed textures.
triggerTerms: red duotone background with full color subject

recipe.visualDefinition: A tight, low-angle portrait of a male figure wearing urban attire (baseball cap, leather jacket) positioned on the right third of the frame. The background is a high-contrast, red-tinted image of a weathered wooden house and bare winter trees. The typography is layered in the bottom left, featuring a glossy 3D script and a distressed sans-serif.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject in full natural color vs. background in red-tinted monochrome
Sharp foreground focus vs. slightly softer, high-contrast background
Glossy, smooth text textures vs. gritty, weathered architectural textures
Diagonal composition created by the subject's head tilt and the roofline
coreInvariants: High-contrast shadows in the background architecture
Layered typography in the lower left quadrant

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Large-scale close-up portrait occupying the right 60% of the frame, tilted slightly toward the center.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's face and red baseball cap serve as the primary focal point.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the subject's eyes, moves down to the bright red jacket, then sweeps left to the bold typography and up into the dark house silhouette.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The dark, shadowed areas of the house provide heavy negative space for the text to pop.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep red and maroon (background tint, cap, jacket)
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Black (deep shadows in the house and trees)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the foreground reds; desaturated but high-contrast values in the background.
paletteRestrictions: Primary focus on red, black, and white
Natural skin tones preserved in the subject

letterConstructionRules: Primary text uses a thick, connected script with a heavy 3D bevel effect
Secondary text uses a condensed, heavy-weight sans-serif with distressed/eroded edges
Both styles utilize thick white outer strokes to separate from the dark background
characterSpecificRedesigns: Script letters feature a glossy, tubular 3D rendering with internal highlights
Sans-serif letters have irregular, 'stamped' or 'weathered' internal textures
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Contrast between fluid, glossy script and rigid, weathered sans-serif.
graphicDevices: Thick white halo/outline around text blocks

candidateDirections.nameOrCategory: Brush Script or Heavy Signage Script
candidateDirections.reason: Provides the base for the 3D beveled effect
Provides the heavy, blocky base for the distressed subtitle

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-contrast urban scene featuring a weathered wooden house and bare trees, tinted in a deep red/maroon duotone. Place a close-up portrait of a man in a red baseball cap and red jacket on the right side, maintaining natural skin tones.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply a large 3D beveled script in red with a thick white outline in the bottom left. Below it, add a condensed, distressed white sans-serif title with a thin black outline.

verificationChecks: Is the background red-tinted while the subject remains natural?
Does the script text have a visible 3D bevel and glossy finish?
Is there a thick white outline separating the text from the dark background?
Is the secondary text visibly distressed or eroded?

adjustableVariables: Intensity of the red background tint
Amount of distress on the secondary font
Depth of the 3D bevel on the script font
mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the subject
Exact architectural details of the house
Specific brand logos on clothing or jewelry

mustAchieve: Strong contrast between subject and background

postGenerationChecks: Check that the white text outline is thick and continuous.
Ensure the red duotone doesn't bleed into the subject's skin tones.
Verify the 3D effect on the script text looks metallic or plastic.
Confirm the background house is dark enough to provide contrast for the text.
recipe.reuseFormula: Urban Portrait + Red Duotone Background + 3D Script Overlay
